checks.title: Privileged containers, privilege escalation, host namespaces or hostPath mounts
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Pods run unprivileged with allowPrivilegeEscalation=false and share no host namespaces or filesystem paths.
checks.remediation: Remove privileged:true, set allowPrivilegeEscalation:false, drop hostNetwork/hostPID/hostIPC and replace hostPath with emptyDir or PersistentVolumes; enforce with Pod Security Admission restricted.

checks.title: Containers run as root (runAsUser 0 or runAsNonRoot false)
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Containers run as a non-root UID with runAsNonRoot=true.
checks.remediation: Set runAsNonRoot:true and a non-zero runAsUser/runAsGroup, and build images that do not require root.

checks.title: Dockerfile with unpinned or latest base image, no USER, or curl-pipe-shell
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Base images are pinned (tag plus digest), the image runs as non-root and no remote script is piped into a shell.
checks.remediation: Pin base images by digest, add a non-root USER, and download installers to a file, verify a checksum or signature, then execute.

checks.title: Terraform open admin ingress, public S3 ACL, or S3 bucket without an explicit server-side encryption configuration
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Admin ports are not reachable from 0.0.0.0/0, buckets are private, and an explicit server-side encryption configuration (ideally KMS) is declared. Note: AWS applies SSE-S3 by default since 2023, so the encryption finding is a policy/KMS-hygiene signal, not proof of plaintext storage.
checks.remediation: Restrict ingress CIDRs to trusted ranges or a bastion/VPN, remove public-read ACLs, enable S3 Block Public Access and a server-side encryption configuration.

checks.title: Plaintext Secret manifest with data committed to source
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Secret values are not stored in source; they come from an external secret manager or are sealed/encrypted.
checks.remediation: Remove literal Secret data from the repository, rotate exposed values and use External Secrets, SealedSecrets or SOPS.

checks.title: cluster-admin bindings or wildcard RBAC rules
checks.expected_secure_behavior: RBAC follows least privilege with explicit verbs and resources, and cluster-admin is not bound to workloads.
checks.remediation: Replace wildcard verbs/resources with the minimum needed, bind namespaced Roles where possible and remove cluster-admin from service accounts.

checks.title: Live cluster RBAC audit using read-only authorized API access
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Effective permissions in the live cluster match the least-privilege design.
checks.remediation: Enumerate bindings with a read-only authorized account, review who can create pods/exec/secrets or escalate, and remove excess grants.
